subject: Data transfer controls & audit language — DPA redlines and e-sign
messages:
From: Gavin Lee <gavin.lee@farsighthealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@farsighthealth.com>, security@farsighthealth.com
Date: 2026-08-04T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Initial DPA redlines + transfer questions

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for the demo last week — Farsight's legal team reviewed the template DPA your team uploaded. We've attached a marked-up copy (Farsight_DPA_redline_20260804.docx) with three areas we need clarity on before we can sign:

1) Cross-border transfers: your DPA references SCCs but doesn't note which SCCs (EU 2010 or the newer 2021 addendum). We require the 2021 SCCs and confirmation on any UK addendum.
2) Subprocessors: request to add two subprocessors (VectorOps and TelemetryCo) to the list; also need a comms plan for new subprocessors with 30-day notice.
3) Audit rights: Farsight requires the right to audit controls annually. We propose either (a) on-site audit with 30 days' notice or (b) remote document review with SOC 2 evidence and up to one on-site visit per 18 months. Please advise.

Also, the security team asked for the latest SOC 2 Type II summary and a short pen-test summary — redacted is OK. Attached are the items we provided last week for reference.

Can your legal/compliance team review our redlines and confirm whether Redwood can accept SCCs 2021 and the audit compromise above? If so we'd like to route the final DPA through DocuSign next week.

Best,
Gavin

Gavin Lee
General Counsel
Farsight Health

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com>
To: Gavin Lee <gavin.lee@farsighthealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-08-04T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial DPA redlines + transfer questions

Gavin — thanks for the quick turn. Looping in Laura (Legal) and Karthik (Compliance) to confirm technical and contractual details.

Quick answers:
- We can accept the 2021 SCCs and will include the UK addendum where applicable. Karthik and team will attach the SCC addendum (SCCs_addendum_v2.pdf) to the final execution set.
- Subprocessors: VectorOps and TelemetryCo are used for ephemeral telemetry and batching; we can add them to the subprocessor list but need to keep certain vendor IP clauses in place. We will provide the 30-day notice process.
- Audit rights: Legal prefers remote evidence review as the standard. Laura — can we compromise with the 'remote-first, 1 in-person every 24 months' language, or is 18 months acceptable?

I'll coordinate with compliance to assemble the SOC2/pen test summaries for you, and we can route to DocuSign once redlines are settled.

Thanks,
Vivek

Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-08-05T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial DPA redlines + transfer questions

Vivek/Gavin — tagging for legal clarity.

1) SCCs: we will commit to the 2021 SCCs with a UK addendum where the customer's data jurisdiction requires it. We'll include a short recital that states the applicable transfer mechanisms per region.

2) Subprocessors: acceptable to add VectorOps and TelemetryCo. We'll include the standard limited liability carveouts and the subprocessor security questionnaire requirement. Regarding notice: we will commit to 'advance written notice of material subprocessor additions' and a 30-day review period — but carve out emergency security patches where immediate onboarding is required (we notify within 72 hours).

3) Audit rights: we cannot accept unlimited on-site audits. Proposed compromise to offer:
   - Annual remote evidence review of SOC 2/pen tests
   - Up to one on-site audit every 24 months, subject to reasonable scope and redaction for vendor/third-party-sensitive data
   - Option for additional on-site audits by mutual agreement and reimbursement of Redwood's incremental costs

If Farsight insists on 18 months, we may need to raise to Exec for approval. Marissa — can you flag this for commercial approval if the customer pushes?

I'll produce a redline that captures the above and send back by EOD tomorrow.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Deputy General Counsel
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@farsighthealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Gavin Lee <gavin.lee@farsighthealth.com>, security@farsighthealth.com
Date: 2026-08-06T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial DPA redlines + transfer questions

Thanks — Laura.

The remote-first + one on-site every 24 months is acceptable as long as the remote evidence review includes raw pen-test findings (redacted) and remediation timelines. For the SCCs: please include a short summary of where Redwood applies SCCs vs. relying on EU adequacy (we are EU-hosted primarily so SCCs 2021 with UK addendum is fine).

Next steps from our side:
- We'll accept your redline and return an executed DocuSign if the e-sign set includes the SCC addendum and the subprocessors list updated.
- We need the SOC 2 Type II summary and the pen-test summary by COB 2026-08-07 for our security review.

Thanks,
Elena

Elena Ruiz
Head of Security Operations
Farsight Health

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-08-10T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Final redline + DocuSign prep

Team — final update; redline attached and preparing e-sign envelope.

Deliverables included in the execution package:
- Final DPA redline (embedded changes): includes 2021 SCCs + UK addendum, updated subprocessor list (VectorOps, TelemetryCo), and the audit rights compromise (remote annual review + one on-site every 24 months).
- SOC2-Type2-2025_summary_redacted.pdf and pen_test_summary_2025_redacted.pdf (restricted) — provided as evidence; full reports available under NDA upon legitimate audit.
- DocuSign envelope prepped (DocuSign link): https://www.docusign.com/placeholder/signed?env=prod&id=22a4b

Please confirm: Marissa — commercial ok on the 24-month on-site cadence? Vivek — shall I send the DocuSign envelope to Elena/Gavin now?

Karthik

Karthik Iyer
Director, Compliance
Redwood Inference
